column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST (cleat#3540, PR 3a): the install test runs one subtest per dialect that supports workflow libraries (PostgreSQL and SQL Server; MySQL has no library schema by decision D41), each through testutil.TestDB, which skips when its DSN is unset. This job configures PostgreSQL only, so the sqlserver subtest skips ONCE while postgres RUNS, and TestAListedInstalledVersionCarriesItsMembersBytes (PostgreSQL only) runs. Measured by name, not by delta: env -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL go test ./engine/ -run '^(TestAnInstallCopiesEveryColumnOfItsMembers|TestAListedInstalledVersionCarriesItsMembersBytes|TestAnInstallDoesNotConvertARowCreatedAfterItsCollisionCheck)$' -count=1 -json reports pass for the listing test, the race test and /postgres_as_a_role_the_policy_applies_to, skip for /sqlserver, and nothing else.
dialect-gated per SUBTEST: the same test and the same one skipped arm; the cluster job runs ./engine/... too and configures PostgreSQL only. See the test-go/engine line for the measurement.

dialect-gated: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so the postgres arm of the install test skips while sqlserver RUNS, and the two PostgreSQL-only tests (the listing test and the race test) skip, three. Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_DB -u CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL go test ./engine/ -run '^(TestAnInstallCopiesEveryColumnOfItsMembers|TestAListedInstalledVersionCarriesItsMembersBytes|TestAnInstallDoesNotConvertARowCreatedAfterItsCollisionCheck)$' -count=1 -json reports skip for the listing test, the race test and /postgres_as_a_role_the_policy_applies_to, pass for /sqlserver.

dialect-gated: this job sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and MySQL has no library schema (D41), so BOTH install arms skip and the two PostgreSQL-only tests (the listing test and the race test) skip, four. That is by decision and not a gap; there is no MySQL arm to run. Measured by name: env -u CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES -u CLEAT_TEST_DB -u CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL go test ./engine/ -run '^(TestAnInstallCopiesEveryColumnOfItsMembers|TestAListedInstalledVersionCarriesItsMembersBytes|TestAnInstallDoesNotConvertARowCreatedAfterItsCollisionCheck)$' -count=1 -json reports skip for both install arms, the listing test and the race test.
